title: Zer0's XP Mod V2
description: XP Mod V2 is a revamp of my previous mod, "Zer0's XP Mod". The features are mostly the same, just some UI revamp and some changes.
body:
# Zer0's XP Mod V2 ⚡

Upgrade your netherite gear like never before with the **dedicated XP Upgrade Block**!  
No more grinding XP ores this mod brings a fresh, streamlined way to boost your XP game.  

✨ **Features:**  
✔️ **XP Upgrade Block** – A brand new block to upgrade your Netherite gear to XP gear! (Only applies to tools, armor is in development)
✔️ **Performance Revamped** – Smoother, faster, and more stable than ever.  
✔️ **Simple & Powerful** – Focused on making XP upgrades straightforward and effective.

⚠️ **Beta Disclaimer**  
🚧 This mod is still fresh and might have some bugs. Use with care, but expect solid performance overall.

💡 Got ideas or feedback? Hit me up at deluxe1delusionnal@gmail.com! Always ready to make the mod better.

📥 Installation Guide  
🔹 Modrinth App (Easiest Method)  
1️⃣ Download and install the Modrinth App.  

2️⃣ Create a new 1.19.2 Forge instance.  

3️⃣ Search for "Zer0's XP Mod V2", and click Install.  

4️⃣ Launch Minecraft and enjoy the mod!  

🔹 Manual Installation (Standalone Minecraft Launcher)  
1️⃣ Install Forge (ensure it matches the mod version).  

2️⃣ Download Zer0's XP Mod V2 from Modrinth.  

3️⃣ Place the .jar file in your mods folder (.minecraft/mods).  

4️⃣ Start Minecraft with the correct Forge profile.  

🌟 **Future Plans**  
🚀 More XP upgrade options and new mechanics coming soon — stay tuned!
